scale.name: Not bootable
scale.meaning: A clean checkout can't install, build and pass its tests.

scale.name: Bootable
scale.meaning: A clean checkout installs, builds and passes every test.

scale.name: Verifiable
scale.meaning: Agents can check their own work: the commands pass, the tests catch planted faults, the instructions are accurate and normal work needs no production access.

scale.name: Delegable
scale.meaning: Agent PRs meet the outcome targets your team set, over at least 20 agent PRs in the window (never fewer than 10).

scale.name: Scalable
scale.meaning: Those targets held over two back-to-back windows while agent PR volume at least doubled.

maturity.rule: The repo level is the lowest level among active components, the assessed components with at least 10% of changes over 90 days; a component joins or leaves that set only after two audits on the same side of the line, except that one the last audit didn't have joins at once; when no assessed component reaches 10%, the largest sets it; and components the audit can't assess never set it.

actions.title: Set up Postgres for agents in hidden-service
actions.why: In a clean container, hidden-service's tests fail because nothing starts Postgres: connection refused on port 5432.
actions.movesTheNeedle: Takes hidden-service to Level 1, covering 100% of recent changes. Agents can run hidden-service's checks before they push, so fewer agent PRs fail CI the first time.
actions.watch: Share of agent PRs touching hidden-service that pass CI the first time. Now: not measured (outcomes need the external-systems tier).

checks.why: Every agent starts from a clean checkout, so setup that only works on a prepared machine breaks every agent run.

checks.name: Build, lint, type-check and test commands pass
checks.why: Agents need one known way to check their own work.

checks.name: Tests catch planted faults
checks.why: Green tests aren't proof that a change is right.
checks.result: hidden-service: tests must pass before faults can be planted

checks.name: Agent instructions are accurate
checks.why: Agents follow AGENTS.md, rules and skills literally, so a stale command costs more than a missing one. No outcome study yet measures how much these files help.

checks.name: Normal work needs no production access
checks.why: Agents run with whatever access setup gives them, so normal work must never need production credentials.
